transcript.text: I inspected all 18 instruments this morning. 14 are serviceable after ordinary cleaning, but 4 have cracked bodies or unsafe keys and should be returned to the donor rather than issued to students. I recorded the inspection on paper, but the donation spreadsheet has not yet been updated.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share an important requirement. I confirmed with the district insurer this week that donated instruments may be used only after each instrument's serial number and condition are entered in the district asset register, and the instruments must be kept in a locked, access-controlled cabinet when not in use. I have not yet attached the insurer's confirmation to the approval packet, but I will do so.
transcript.speaker: A3
